Con el torso quieto, llevá el maneral hacia el cuerpo con los brazos pegados, hasta tocar el abdomen, soltando el aire. Apretá fuerte la espalda un segundo y volvé despacio tomando aire.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Elliptical Trainer
instructions: To begin, step onto the elliptical and select the desired option from the menu. Most ellipticals have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout.
The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.
pasos: Subite al elíptico y elegí la opción deseada en el menú. La mayoría tiene modo manual o programas. En general podés cargar edad y peso para estimar las calorías. Podés ajustar la inclinación para cambiar la intensidad.
Los sensores de las manijas miden tu pulso para mantener una intensidad adecuada.

name: Exercise Ball Crunch
instructions: Lie on an exercise ball with your lower back curvature pressed against the spherical surface of the ball. Your feet should be bent at the knee and pressed firmly against the floor. The upper torso should be hanging off the top of the ball. The arms should either be kept alongside the body or crossed on top of your chest as these positions avoid neck strains (as opposed to the hands behind the back of the head position).
Lower your torso into a stretch position keeping the neck stationary at all times. This will be your starting position.

With the hips stationary, flex the waist by contracting the abdominals and curl the shoulders and trunk upward until you feel a nice contraction on your abdominals. The arms should simply slide up the side of your legs if you have them at the side or just stay on top of your chest if you have them crossed. The lower back should always stay in contact with the ball. Exhale as you perform this movement and hold the contraction for a second.
As you inhale, go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Acostate sobre una pelota suiza con la curva lumbar apoyada en la pelota, rodillas flexionadas y pies firmes en el piso. La parte alta del torso queda fuera de la pelota. Los brazos van al costado del cuerpo o cruzados sobre el pecho, para no forzar el cuello (mejor que con las manos detrás de la cabeza).
Bajá el torso hasta estirarte, con el cuello quieto. Esta es la posición inicial.

Con la cadera quieta, flexioná la cintura contrayendo el abdomen y subí hombros y tronco hasta sentir una buena contracción. Los brazos se deslizan por las piernas o quedan sobre el pecho. La zona lumbar siempre en contacto con la pelota. Soltá el aire y sostené un segundo.
Tomando aire, volvé a la posición inicial.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Exercise Ball Pull-In
nombre: Rodillas al pecho con pelota suiza
instructions: Place an exercise ball nearby and lay on the floor in front of it with your hands on the floor shoulder width apart in a push-up position.

Now place your lower shins on top of an exercise ball. Tip: At this point your legs should be fully extended with the shins on top of the ball and the upper body should be in a push-up type of position being supported by your two extended arms in front of you. This will be your starting position.

While keeping your back completely straight and the upper body stationary, pull your knees in towards your chest as you exhale, allowing the ball to roll forward under your ankles. Squeeze your abs and hold that position for a second.
Now slowly straighten your legs, rolling the ball back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Con una pelota suiza cerca, ponete en posición de flexión delante de ella, con las manos al ancho de los hombros.
Apoyá la parte baja de las canillas sobre la pelota. Consejo: piernas estiradas sobre la pelota y el torso sostenido por los brazos estirados. Esta es la posición inicial.
Con la espalda bien recta y el torso quieto, llevá las rodillas al pecho soltando el aire, dejando que la pelota ruede bajo los tobillos. Apretá el abdomen un segundo.
Estirá las piernas despacio, rodando la pelota a la posición inicial, tomando aire.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Extended Range One-Arm Kettlebell Floor Press
nombre: Press a un brazo con pesa rusa en el piso (recorrido amplio)
instructions: Lie on the floor and position a kettlebell for one arm to press. The kettlebell should be held by the handle. The leg on the same side that you are pressing should be bent, with the knee crossing over the midline of the body.
Press the kettlebell by extending the elbow and adducting the arm, pressing it above your body. Return to the starting position.
pasos: Acostate en el piso con una pesa rusa para empujar con un brazo, agarrada por la manija. La pierna del mismo lado va flexionada, con la rodilla cruzando la línea media del cuerpo.
Empujá la pesa estirando el codo y llevando el brazo hacia el centro, por encima del cuerpo. Volvé a la posición inicial.

name: External Rotation
nombre: Rotación externa de hombro con mancuerna
instructions: Lie sideways on a flat bench with one arm holding a dumbbell and the other hand on top of the bench folded so that you can rest your head on it.
Bend the elbows of the arm holding the dumbbell so that it creates a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm. Tip: Keep the arm parallel to your torso.

Now bend the elbow while keeping the upper arm stationary. In this manner, the forearm will be parallel to the floor and perpendicular to your torso (Tip: So the forearm will be directly in front of you). The upper arm will be stationary by your torso and should be parallel to the floor (aligned with your torso at all times). This will be your starting position.

As you breathe out, externally rotate your forearm so that the dumbbell is lifted up in a semicircle motion as you maintain the 90 degree angle bend between the upper arms and the forearm. You will continue this external rotation until the forearm is perpendicular to the floor and the torso pointing towards the ceiling. At this point you will hold the contraction for a second.
As you breathe in, slowly go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch to the other arm.
pasos: Acostate de costado en un banco plano con una mancuerna en una mano y el otro brazo doblado sobre el banco para apoyar la cabeza.
Flexioná el codo del brazo con la mancuerna a 90 grados. Consejo: el brazo queda paralelo al torso.
Sin mover la parte superior del brazo, ubicá el antebrazo paralelo al piso y perpendicular al torso (justo delante tuyo). Esta es la posición inicial.
Soltando el aire, rotá el antebrazo hacia afuera subiendo la mancuerna en semicírculo, sin cambiar los 90 grados del codo, hasta que apunte al techo. Sostené un segundo.
Tomando aire, volvé despacio a la posición inicial.
Repetí las veces indicadas y cambiá de brazo.

name: External Rotation with Band
nombre: Rotación externa de hombro con banda
instructions: Choke the band around a post. The band should be at the same height as your elbow. Stand with your left side to the band a couple of feet away.
Grasp the end of the band with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place with your elbow to keep it firmly in position.
With your upper arm in position, your elbow should be flexed to 90 degrees with your hand reaching across the front of your torso. This will be your starting position.
Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a backhand motion, keeping your elbow in place.
Continue as far as you are able, pause, and then return to the starting position.
pasos: Enlazá la banda en un poste a la altura del codo. Parate con el lado izquierdo hacia la banda, a unos 60 cm.
Agarrá la punta de la banda con la mano derecha y mantené el codo firme contra el costado. Conviene sostener una almohadilla o rodillo con el codo para fijarlo.
Con el brazo en posición, el codo flexionado a 90 grados y la mano cruzando por delante del torso. Esta es la posición inicial.
Rotá el brazo hacia afuera, como un revés de tenis, sin mover el codo.
Llegá hasta donde puedas, pausá y volvé a la posición inicial.

name: External Rotation with Cable
nombre: Rotación externa de hombro en polea
instructions: Adjust the cable to the same height as your elbow. Stand with your left side to the band a couple of feet away.
Grasp the handle with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place with your elbow to keep it firmly in position.
With your upper arm in position, your elbow should be flexed to 90 degrees with your hand reaching across the front of your torso. This will be your starting position.
Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a backhand motion, keeping your elbow in place.
pasos: Ajustá la polea a la altura del codo. Parate con el lado izquierdo hacia la polea, a unos 60 cm.
Agarrá la manija con la mano derecha y mantené el codo firme contra el costado. Conviene sostener una almohadilla o rodillo con el codo para fijarlo.
Con el brazo en posición, el codo flexionado a 90 grados y la mano cruzando por delante del torso. Esta es la posición inicial.
Rotá el brazo hacia afuera, como un revés de tenis, sin mover el codo.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Facing a high pulley with a rope or dual handles attached, pull the weight directly towards your face, separating your hands as you do so. Keep your upper arms parallel to the ground.
pasos: Frente a una polea alta con soga o doble manija, tirá del peso directo hacia la cara, separando las manos al llegar. Mantené la parte superior de los brazos paralela al piso.

name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: There are various implements that can be used for the farmers walk. These can also be performed with heavy dumbbells or short bars if these implements aren't available. Begin by standing between the implements.
After gripping the handles, lift them up by driving through your heels, keeping your back straight and your head up.
Walk taking short, quick steps, and don't forget to breathe. Move for a given distance, typically 50-100 feet, as fast as possible.
pasos: Hay implementos específicos para el paseo del granjero, pero también podés usar mancuernas pesadas o barras cortas. Parate entre los implementos.
Agarrá las manijas y levantalas empujando con los talones, espalda recta y cabeza arriba.
Caminá con pasos cortos y rápidos, sin dejar de respirar, una distancia determinada (normalmente 15 a 30 metros) lo más rápido posible.

name: Fast Skipping
instructions: Start in a relaxed position with one leg slightly forward. This will be your starting position.
Skip by executing a step-hop pattern of right-right-step to left-left-step, and so on, alternating back and forth.
Perform fast skips by maintaining close contact with the ground and reduce air time, moving as quickly as possible.
pasos: Empezá relajado con una pierna un poco adelantada. Esta es la posición inicial.
Hacé skipping con el patrón paso-salto: derecha-derecha-paso, izquierda-izquierda-paso, alternando.
Para el skipping rápido, mantené los pies cerca del piso y reducí el tiempo en el aire, moviéndote lo más rápido posible.

name: Finger Curls
instructions: Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing up; hands spaced about shoulder width.
Place your feet flat on the floor, at a distance that is slightly wider than shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
Lower the bar as far as possible by extending the fingers. Allowing the bar to roll down the hands, catch the bar with the final joint in the fingers.
Now curl bar up as high as possible by closing your hands while exhaling. Hold the contraction at the top.
pasos: Sostené una barra con las dos manos, palmas hacia arriba, separadas al ancho de los hombros.
Pies apoyados en el piso, un poco más abiertos que los hombros. Esta es la posición inicial.
Bajá la barra lo más posible estirando los dedos, dejándola rodar por las manos hasta sostenerla con la última falange.
Subí la barra lo más alto posible cerrando las manos, soltando el aire. Sostené arriba.

name: Flat Bench Cable Flyes
nombre: Aperturas en polea baja en banco plano
instructions: Position a flat bench between two low pulleys so that when you are laying on it, your chest will be lined up with the cable pulleys.
Lay flat on the bench and keep your feet on the ground.
Have someone hand you the handles on each hand. You will grab each single handle attachment with a palms up grip.

Extend your arms by your side with a slight bend on your elbows. Tip: You will keep this bend constant through the whole movement. Your arms should be parallel to the floor. This is your starting position.

Now start lifting the arms in a semi-circle motion directly in front of you by pulling the cables together until both hands meet at the top of the movement. Squeeze your chest as you perform this motion and breathe out during this movement. Also, hold the contraction for a second at the top. Tip: When performed correctly, at the top position of this movement, your arms should be perpendicular to your torso and the floor touching above your chest.
Slowly come back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Poné un banco plano entre dos poleas bajas, de modo que acostado el pecho quede alineado con las poleas.
Acostate en el banco con los pies en el piso.
Pedí que te alcancen las manijas; agarralas con las palmas hacia arriba.
Abrí los brazos a los costados con los codos apenas flexionados (esa flexión no cambia en todo el movimiento), paralelos al piso. Esta es la posición inicial.

Subí los brazos en semicírculo delante tuyo hasta que las manos se junten arriba, apretando el pecho y soltando el aire. Sostené un segundo. Consejo: arriba, los brazos quedan perpendiculares al torso y al piso, con las manos tocándose sobre el pecho.
Volvé despacio a la posición inicial.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
nombre: Encogimiento de piernas en banco plano
instructions: Lie on an exercise mat or a flat bench with your legs off the end.

Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench (or with palms down by the side on an exercise mat). Also extend your legs straight out. This will be your starting position.
Bend your knees and pull your upper thighs into your midsection as you breathe out. Continue this movement until your knees are near your chest. Hold the contracted position for a second.
As you breathe in, slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Acostate en una colchoneta o en un banco plano con las piernas afuera del borde.
Poné las manos debajo de los glúteos con las palmas abajo, o a los costados agarrando el banco. Estirá las piernas. Esta es la posición inicial.
Flexioná las rodillas y llevá los muslos hacia el abdomen soltando el aire, hasta que las rodillas queden cerca del pecho. Sostené un segundo.
Tomando aire, volvé despacio a la posición inicial.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
nombre: Elevación de piernas acostado en banco plano
instructions: Lie with your back flat on a bench and your legs extended in front of you off the end.
Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench. This will be your starting position.

As you keep your legs extended, straight as possible with your knees slightly bent but locked raise your legs until they make a 90-degree angle with the floor. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second.
Now, as you inhale, slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
pasos: Acostate con la espalda plana en un banco y las piernas estiradas afuera del borde.
Poné las manos debajo de los glúteos con las palmas abajo, o a los costados agarrando el banco. Esta es la posición inicial.
Con las piernas estiradas (rodillas apenas flexionadas pero fijas), subilas hasta que formen 90 grados con el piso. Soltá el aire y sostené un segundo arriba.
Tomando aire, bajá las piernas despacio a la posición inicial.

name: Flexor Incline Dumbbell Curls
instructions: Hold the dumbbell towards the side farther from you so that you have more weight on the side closest to you. (This can be done for a good effect on all bicep dumbbell exercises). Now do a normal incline dumbbell curl, but keep your wrists as far back as possible so as to neutralize any stress that is placed on them.
Sit on an incline bench that is angled at 45-degrees while holding a dumbbell on each hand.

Let your arms hang down on your sides, with the elbows in, and turn the palms of your hands forward with the thumbs pointing away from the body. Tip: You will keep this hand position throughout the movement as there should not be any twisting of the hands as they come up. This will be your starting position.

Curl up the two dumbbells at the same time until your biceps are fully contracted and exhale. Tip: Do not swing the arms or use momentum. Keep a controlled motion at all times. Hold the contracted position for a second at the top.
As you inhale, slowly go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Agarrá la mancuerna más cerca del disco exterior, para cargar más peso del lado de adentro (sirve para cualquier curl con mancuernas). Hacé un curl inclinado normal, pero con las muñecas lo más atrás posible para no cargarlas.
Sentate en un banco inclinado a 45 grados con una mancuerna en cada mano.
Dejá colgar los brazos al costado, codos adentro, palmas hacia adelante y pulgares hacia afuera. Consejo: las manos no giran durante el movimiento. Esta es la posición inicial.
Subí las dos mancuernas a la vez hasta contraer del todo los bíceps, soltando el aire. Consejo: sin balanceos ni impulso. Sostené un segundo arriba.
Tomando aire, volvé despacio a la posición inicial.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Floor Glute-Ham Raise
instructions: You can use a partner for this exercise or brace your feet under something stable.
Begin on your knees with your upper legs and torso upright. If using a partner, they will firmly hold your feet to keep you in position. This will be your starting position.
Lower yourself by extending at the knee, taking care to NOT flex the hips as you go forward.

Place your hands in front of you as you reach the floor. This movement is very difficult and you may be unable to do it unaided. Use your arms to lightly push off the floor to aid your return to the starting position.
pasos: Podés hacerlo con un compañero o trabando los pies debajo de algo firme.
Arrodillate con muslos y torso derechos. Si tenés compañero, que te sostenga firme los pies. Esta es la posición inicial.
Bajá estirando las rodillas, cuidando de NO flexionar la cadera al ir hacia adelante.
Apoyá las manos al llegar al piso. Es un ejercicio muy difícil y quizá no puedas hacerlo sin ayuda: usá los brazos para empujarte suavemente desde el piso y volver.

name: Floor Press
nombre: Press de banca en el piso con barra
instructions: Adjust the j-hooks so they are at the appropriate height to rack the bar. Begin lying on the floor with your head near the end of a power rack. Keeping your shoulder blades pulled together; pull the bar off of the hooks.

Lower the bar towards the bottom of your chest or upper stomach, squeezing the bar and attempting to pull it apart as you do so. Ensure that you tuck your elbows throughout the movement. Lower the bar until your upper arm contacts the ground and pause, preventing any slamming or bouncing of the weight.
Press the bar back up as fast as you can, keeping the bar, your wrists, and elbows in line as you do so.
pasos: Ajustá los ganchos del rack a la altura adecuada. Acostate en el piso con la cabeza cerca de la punta del rack. Con los omóplatos juntos, sacá la barra de los ganchos.

Bajá la barra hacia el pecho bajo o la parte alta del abdomen, apretándola como si quisieras separarla y con los codos cerrados. Bajá hasta que la parte superior del brazo toque el piso y pausá, sin golpear ni rebotar.
Empujá la barra hacia arriba lo más rápido que puedas, con barra, muñecas y codos alineados.

name: Floor Press with Chains
nombre: Press en el piso con cadenas
instructions: Adjust the j-hooks so they are at the appropriate height to rack the bar. For this exercise, drape the chains directly over the end of the bar, trying to keep the ends away from the plates.
Begin lying on the floor with your head near the end of a power rack. Keeping your shoulder blades pulled together, pull the bar off of the hooks.

Lower the bar towards the bottom of your chest or upper stomach, squeezing the bar and attempting to pull it apart as you do so. Ensure that you tuck your elbows throughout the movement. Lower the bar until your upper arm contacts the ground and pause, preventing any slamming or bouncing of the weight.
Press the bar back up as fast as you can, keeping the bar, your wrists, and elbows in line as you do so.
pasos: Ajustá los ganchos del rack a la altura adecuada. Colgá las cadenas directamente en las puntas de la barra, lejos de los discos.
Acostate en el piso con la cabeza cerca de la punta del rack. Con los omóplatos juntos, sacá la barra de los ganchos.

Bajá la barra hacia el pecho bajo o la parte alta del abdomen, apretándola como si quisieras separarla y con los codos cerrados. Bajá hasta que la parte superior del brazo toque el piso y pausá, sin golpear ni rebotar.
Empujá la barra hacia arriba lo más rápido que puedas, con barra, muñecas y codos alineados.

name: Flutter Kicks
nombre: Patadas alternas boca abajo en banco
instructions: On a flat bench lie facedown with the hips on the edge of the bench, the legs straight with toes high off the floor and with the arms on top of the bench holding on to the front edge.
Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings and straighten the legs until they are level with the hips. This will be your starting position.
Start the movement by lifting the left leg higher than the right leg.
Then lower the left leg as you lift the right leg.

Continue alternating in this manner (as though you are doing a flutter kick in water) until you have done the recommended amount of repetitions for each leg. Make sure that you keep a controlled movement at all times. Tip: You will breathe normally as you perform this movement.
pasos: Acostate boca abajo en un banco plano con la cadera en el borde, las piernas estiradas con las puntas lejos del piso, y agarrate del borde delantero del banco.
Apretá glúteos e isquiotibiales y subí las piernas hasta que queden a la altura de la cadera. Esta es la posición inicial.
Subí la pierna izquierda más alto que la derecha.
Bajá la izquierda mientras subís la derecha.
Seguí alternando, como pataleando en el agua, hasta completar las repeticiones con cada pierna. Siempre con control. Consejo: respirá normalmente.

name: Foot-SMR
nombre: Automasaje de la planta del pie
instructions: This exercise stretches the fascia of the muscles in the feet. Start off seated with your shoes removed. Using a foot roller or a similar object, such as a small section of pvc pipe, place your foot against the roller across the arch of your foot. This will be your starting position.
Press down firmly, rolling across the arch of your foot. Hold for 10-30 seconds, and then switch feet.
pasos: Este ejercicio estira la fascia de los músculos del pie. Sentate descalzo. Con un rodillo para pies o algo parecido (un tramo de caño de PVC), apoyá el arco del pie sobre el rodillo. Esta es la posición inicial.
Presioná firme y rodá a lo largo del arco del pie. Sostené 10 a 30 segundos y cambiá de pie.

name: Forward Drag with Press
nombre: Arrastre de trineo hacia adelante con empuje
instructions: Attach a dual handled chain or rope attachment to the sled. You should be facing away from the sled, holding a handle in each hand.

Begin the movement by moving forward for one step. Leaning forward, extend through the legs and hips to move, pausing with each step to extend through the elbows, pressing your hands forward. Step forward until you return to the start position prepared to press.
pasos: Enganchá al trineo una cadena o soga con dos manijas. De espaldas al trineo, agarrá una manija con cada mano.
Da un paso adelante inclinándote y empujando con piernas y cadera. En cada paso, pausá y estirá los codos empujando las manos hacia adelante. Avanzá hasta volver a la posición de empujar.

name: Frankenstein Squat
instructions: This drill teaches you the proper positioning of both the bar and your body during the clean and front squat.

Place the barbell on the front of the shoulders, releasing your grip and extending your arms out in front of you. The shoulders should be pushed forward to create a shelf, and the bar should be in contact with the throat. Ensure that you only move your shoulder blades forward; don't round the thoracic spine.

Squat by flexing the knees and hips, sitting in between your legs. Keep the torso upright, the arms up, and the shoulders forward, and the bar should stay in place. Go to the bottom of the squat, until your hamstrings contact your calves.
Return to the upright position by driving through the front of the heel and extending the knees and hips.
pasos: Este ejercicio enseña la posición correcta de la barra y del cuerpo en la cargada y la sentadilla frontal.

Apoyá la barra delante de los hombros, soltá las manos y estirá los brazos hacia adelante. Los hombros van adelantados formando un estante, con la barra tocando la garganta. Adelantá solo los omóplatos, sin redondear la espalda.

Agachate flexionando rodillas y cadera, bajando entre las piernas. Torso derecho, brazos arriba y hombros adelante, sin que la barra se mueva. Bajá hasta el fondo, hasta que los isquiotibiales toquen los gemelos.
Subí empujando con la parte delantera del talón y extendiendo rodillas y cadera.

name: Freehand Jump Squat
instructions: Cross your arms over your chest.
With your head up and your back straight, position your feet at shoulder width.
Keeping your back straight and chest up, squat down as you inhale until your upper thighs are parallel, or lower, to the floor.
Now pressing mainly with the ball of your feet, jump straight up in the air as high as possible, using the thighs like springs. Exhale during this portion of the movement.
When you touch the floor again, immediately squat down and jump again.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Cruzá los brazos sobre el pecho.
Cabeza arriba, espalda recta y pies al ancho de los hombros.
Con la espalda recta y el pecho arriba, agachate tomando aire hasta que los muslos queden paralelos al piso o más abajo.
Empujando sobre todo con la parte delantera de los pies, saltá lo más alto posible, usando los muslos como resortes. Soltá el aire.
Al tocar el piso, agachate enseguida y volvé a saltar.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Frog Hops
instructions: Stand with your hands behind your head, and squat down keeping your torso upright and your head up. This will be your starting position.
Jump forward several feet, avoiding jumping unnecessarily high. As your feet contact the ground, absorb the impact through your legs, and jump again. Repeat this action 5-10 times.
pasos: Parate con las manos detrás de la cabeza y agachate con el torso derecho y la cabeza arriba. Esta es la posición inicial.
Saltá hacia adelante un par de metros, sin saltar más alto de lo necesario. Al caer, absorbé el impacto con las piernas y volvé a saltar. Repetí 5 a 10 veces.

name: Frog Sit-Ups
instructions: Lie with your back flat on the floor (or exercise mat) and your legs extended in front of you.
Now bend at the knees and place your outer thighs by the floor (or mat) as you make the soles of your feet touch each other.

Now try pushing both soles and bringing them up as near you as possible while you keep the outer thighs on the floor (or at least almost touching it). Tip: In this position your legs should create a diamond shape.
Now, cross your arms in front of you by touching the opposite shoulders. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale flatten your lower back to the floor while curling the torso upwards. Tip: This will be like performing the first 1/4 movement of a sit up. Hold at the top position for a second.
As you inhale, slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Acostate boca arriba en el piso o una colchoneta con las piernas estiradas.
Flexioná las rodillas y dejá caer los muslos hacia afuera, juntando las plantas de los pies.
Acercá las plantas lo más que puedas hacia vos, con los muslos apoyados (o casi) en el piso. Consejo: las piernas forman un rombo.
Cruzá los brazos tocando los hombros contrarios. Esta es la posición inicial.
Soltando el aire, pegá la zona lumbar al piso y subí el torso, como el primer cuarto de un abdominal. Sostené un segundo.
Tomando aire, bajá despacio a la posición inicial.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Front Barbell Squat
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, bring your arms up under the bar while keeping the elbows high and the upper arm slightly above parallel to the floor. Rest the bar on top of the deltoids and cross your arms while grasping the bar for total control.
Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor mainly with the middle of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Por seguridad, hacelo dentro de un rack. Poné la barra a la altura adecuada. Con la barra cargada, pasá los brazos por debajo con los codos altos y la parte superior del brazo apenas por encima de la horizontal. Apoyá la barra sobre los deltoides y cruzá los brazos agarrándola para controlarla.
Sacala del rack empujando con las piernas mientras enderezás el torso.
Alejate del rack, pies al ancho de los hombros y puntas un poco hacia afuera. Cabeza arriba siempre y espalda recta. Esta es la posición inicial.

Bajá despacio flexionando las rodillas con la postura recta y la cabeza arriba, hasta que el ángulo entre muslo y gemelo sea un poco menor a 90 grados (muslos debajo de la paralela). Tomá aire. Consejo: la rodilla queda alineada con la punta del pie; si la pasa, cargás de más la rodilla.
Subí soltando el aire, empujando el piso sobre todo con el medio del pie, hasta la posición inicial.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Front Barbell Squat To A Bench
nombre: Sentadilla frontal con barra a banco
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set a flat bench behind you and set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, bring your arms up under the bar while keeping the elbows high and the upper arm slightly above parallel to the floor. Rest the bar on top of the deltoids and cross your arms while grasping the bar for total control.
Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until you touch the bench with your glutes. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor mainly with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Por seguridad, hacelo dentro de un rack, con un banco plano detrás. Poné la barra a la altura adecuada. Con la barra cargada, pasá los brazos por debajo con los codos altos, apoyala sobre los deltoides y cruzá los brazos agarrándola.
Sacala del rack empujando con las piernas mientras enderezás el torso.
Alejate del rack, pies al ancho de los hombros y puntas un poco hacia afuera. Cabeza arriba y espalda recta. Esta es la posición inicial.
Bajá despacio flexionando las rodillas con la postura recta, hasta tocar el banco con los glúteos. Tomá aire. Consejo: la rodilla queda alineada con la punta del pie.
Subí soltando el aire, empujando el piso sobre todo con el talón, hasta la posición inicial.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Front Box Jump
instructions: Begin with a box of an appropriate height 1-2 feet in front of you. Stand with your feet should width apart. This will be your starting position.
Perform a short squat in preparation for jumping, swinging your arms behind you.
Rebound out of this position, extending through the hips, knees, and ankles to jump as high as possible. Swing your arms forward and up.
Land on the box with the knees bent, absorbing the impact through the legs. You can jump from the box back to the ground, or preferably step down one leg at a time.
pasos: Poné un cajón de altura adecuada a unos 30 a 60 cm delante tuyo. Parate con los pies al ancho de los hombros. Esta es la posición inicial.
Hacé una sentadilla corta para preparar el salto, llevando los brazos atrás.
Rebotá extendiendo cadera, rodillas y tobillos para saltar lo más alto posible, llevando los brazos hacia adelante y arriba.
Caé en el cajón con las rodillas flexionadas, absorbiendo el impacto. Podés saltar de vuelta al piso, aunque es mejor bajar de a una pierna.

name: Front Cable Raise
nombre: Elevación frontal en polea baja a un brazo
instructions: Select the weight on a low pulley machine and grasp the single hand cable attachment that is attached to the low pulley with your left hand.

Face away from the pulley and put your arm straight down with the hand cable attachment in front of your thighs at arms' length with the palms of the hand facing your thighs. This will be your starting position.

While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the left arm to the front with a slight bend on the elbow and the palms of the hand always faces down. Continue to go up until you arm is slightly above parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this portion of the movement and pause for a second at the top.
Now as you inhale lower the arm back down slowly to the starting position.
Once all of the recommended amount of repetitions have been performed for this arm, switch arms and perform the exercise with the right one.
pasos: Elegí el peso en una polea baja y agarrá la manija con la mano izquierda.
De espaldas a la polea, con el brazo estirado hacia abajo y la manija delante de los muslos, palma hacia el muslo. Esta es la posición inicial.

Con el torso quieto (sin balanceo), subí el brazo hacia adelante con el codo apenas flexionado y la palma hacia abajo, hasta un poco por encima de la horizontal. Soltá el aire y pausá un segundo arriba.
Tomando aire, bajá el brazo despacio a la posición inicial.
Al terminar las repeticiones, cambiá de brazo.

name: Front Cone Hops (or hurdle hops)
instructions: Set up a row of cones or other small barriers, placing them a few feet apart.
Stand in front of the first cone with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
Begin by jumping with both feet over the first cone, swinging both arms as you jump.
Absorb the impact of landing by bending the knees, rebounding out of the first leap by jumping over the next cone.
Continue until you have jumped over all of the cones.
pasos: Poné una fila de conos u obstáculos chicos separados un metro o más.
Parate frente al primer cono con los pies al ancho de los hombros. Esta es la posición inicial.
Saltá el primer cono con los dos pies, balanceando los brazos.
Absorbé el impacto flexionando las rodillas y rebotá para saltar el cono siguiente.
Seguí hasta saltar todos los conos.

name: Front Dumbbell Raise
instructions: Pick a couple of dumbbells and stand with a straight torso and the dumbbells on front of your thighs at arms length with the palms of the hand facing your thighs. This will be your starting position.

While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the left dumbbell to the front with a slight bend on the elbow and the palms of the hands always facing down. Continue to go up until you arm is slightly above parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this portion of the movement and pause for a second at the top. Inhale after the second pause.
Now lower the dumbbell back down slowly to the starting position as you simultaneously lift the right dumbbell.
Continue alternating in this fashion until all of the recommended amount of repetitions have been performed for each arm.
pasos: Agarrá un par de mancuernas y parate con el torso derecho, las pesas delante de los muslos y las palmas hacia los muslos. Esta es la posición inicial.

Con el torso quieto (sin balanceo), subí la mancuerna izquierda hacia adelante con el codo apenas flexionado y la palma hacia abajo, hasta un poco por encima de la horizontal. Soltá el aire, pausá un segundo arriba y tomá aire.
Bajá despacio la mancuerna izquierda mientras subís la derecha.
Seguí alternando hasta completar las repeticiones con cada brazo.

name: Front Incline Dumbbell Raise
instructions: Sit down on an incline bench with the incline set anywhere between 30 to 60 degrees while holding a dumbbell on each hand. Tip: You can change the angle to hit the muscle a little differently each time.
Extend your arms straight in front of you and have your palms facing down with the dumbbells raised about 1 inch above your thighs. This will be your starting position.

Slowly raise the dumbbells straight up until they are slightly above your shoulders, while keeping your elbows locked. Squeeze at the top for a second and make sure you breathe out during this portion of the movement. Tip: Keep your head resting down against the bench and your legs on the floor at all times.
Lower the arms back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Sentate en un banco inclinado entre 30 y 60 grados con una mancuerna en cada mano. Consejo: podés variar el ángulo para trabajar el músculo un poco distinto.
Estirá los brazos hacia adelante con las palmas hacia abajo y las mancuernas unos 2,5 cm por encima de los muslos. Esta es la posición inicial.

Subí las mancuernas despacio hasta un poco por encima de los hombros, con los codos bloqueados. Apretá un segundo arriba soltando el aire. Consejo: cabeza apoyada en el banco y piernas en el piso todo el tiempo.
Bajá a la posición inicial tomando aire.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Front Leg Raises
instructions: Stand next to a chair or other support, holding on with one hand.
Swing your leg forward, keeping the leg straight. Continue with a downward swing, bringing the leg as far back as your flexibility allows. Repeat 5-10 times, and then switch legs.
pasos: Parate al lado de una silla u otro apoyo, agarrándote con una mano.
Balanceá la pierna estirada hacia adelante y después hacia atrás, hasta donde te permita la flexibilidad. Repetí 5 a 10 veces y cambiá de pierna.

name: Front Plate Raise
instructions: While standing straight, hold a barbell plate in both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions. Your palms should be facing each other and your arms should be extended and locked with a slight bend at the elbows and the plate should be down near your waist in front of you as far as you can go. Tip: The arms will remain in this position throughout the exercise. This will be your starting position.

Slowly raise the plate as you exhale until it is a little above shoulder level. Hold the contraction for a second. Tip: make sure that you do not swing the weight or bend at the elbows. Your torso should remain stationary throughout the movement as well.
As you inhale, slowly lower the plate back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: De pie y derecho, sostené un disco con las dos manos en posición de las 3 y las 9, palmas enfrentadas, brazos estirados con los codos apenas flexionados y el disco abajo, delante de la cintura. Consejo: los brazos no cambian de forma en todo el ejercicio. Esta es la posición inicial.
Subí el disco despacio soltando el aire hasta un poco por encima de los hombros. Sostené un segundo. Consejo: sin balancear ni doblar los codos; el torso queda quieto.
Tomando aire, bajá despacio a la posición inicial.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Front Raise And Pullover
nombre: Elevación frontal y pullover acostado con barra
instructions: Lie on a flat bench while holding a barbell using a palms down grip that is about 15 inches apart.
Place the bar on your upper thighs, extend your arms and lock them while keeping a slight bend on the elbows. This will be your starting position.

Now raise the weight using a semicircular motion and keeping your arms straight as you inhale. Continue the same movement until the bar is on the other side above your head . (Tip: the bar will travel approximately 180-degrees). At this point your arms should be parallel to the floor with the palms of your hands facing the ceiling.
Now return the barbell to the starting position by reversing the motion as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Acostate en un banco plano sosteniendo una barra con agarre prono, manos separadas unos 40 cm.
Apoyá la barra sobre los muslos, con los brazos estirados y los codos apenas flexionados. Esta es la posición inicial.

Subí la barra en semicírculo con los brazos estirados, tomando aire, hasta llevarla al otro lado por encima de la cabeza (recorre unos 180 grados). Ahí los brazos quedan paralelos al piso con las palmas hacia el techo.
Volvé a la posición inicial haciendo el recorrido inverso, soltando el aire.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Front Squat (Clean Grip)
nombre: Sentadilla frontal con agarre de cargada
instructions: To begin, first set the bar in a rack slightly below shoulder level. Rest the bar on top of the deltoids, pushing into the clavicles, and lightly touching the throat. Your hands should be in a clean grip, touching the bar only with your fingers to help keep it in position.

Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso. Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head and elbows up at all times. This will be your starting position.

Bend at the knees, sitting down between your legs. Continue down until your hamstrings are on your calves. Keep your knees aligned with your feet by consciously using your abductors to push your knees out as you squat.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor mainly with the heel or middle of your foot as you straighten the legs again and return to the starting position.
pasos: Poné la barra en un rack un poco debajo de la altura de los hombros. Apoyala sobre los deltoides, contra las clavículas y rozando la garganta. Agarre de cargada, tocando la barra solo con los dedos para mantenerla en su lugar.
Sacala del rack empujando con las piernas mientras enderezás el torso. Alejate, pies al ancho de los hombros y puntas un poco hacia afuera. Cabeza y codos arriba siempre. Esta es la posición inicial.
Flexioná las rodillas bajando entre las piernas, hasta que los isquiotibiales toquen los gemelos. Mantené las rodillas alineadas con los pies empujándolas hacia afuera.
Subí soltando el aire, empujando el piso con el talón o el medio del pie, hasta la posición inicial.

name: Front Squats With Two Kettlebells
nombre: Sentadilla frontal con dos pesas rusas
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so.

Looking straight ahead at all times, squat as low as you can and pause at the bottom. As you squat down, push your knees out. You should squat between your legs, keeping an upright torso, with your head and chest up.
Rise back up by driving through your heels and repeat.
pasos: Llevá dos pesas rusas a los hombros extendiendo piernas y cadera mientras las subís, girando las muñecas.
Mirando siempre al frente, agachate lo más profundo que puedas y pausá abajo. Empujá las rodillas hacia afuera y bajá entre las piernas, con el torso derecho y cabeza y pecho arriba.
Subí empujando con los talones y repetí.

name: Front Two-Dumbbell Raise
instructions: Pick a couple of dumbbells and stand with a straight torso and the dumbbells on front of your thighs at arms length with the palms of the hand facing your thighs. This will be your starting position.

While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the dumbbells to the front with a slight bend on the elbow and the palms of the hands always facing down. Continue to go up until you arms are slightly above parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this portion of the movement and pause for a second at the top.
As you inhale, lower the dumbbells back down slowly to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Agarrá un par de mancuernas y parate con el torso derecho, las pesas delante de los muslos y las palmas hacia los muslos. Esta es la posición inicial.

Con el torso quieto (sin balanceo), subí las mancuernas hacia adelante con los codos apenas flexionados y las palmas hacia abajo, hasta un poco por encima de la horizontal. Soltá el aire y pausá un segundo arriba.
Tomando aire, bajá despacio a la posición inicial.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Full Range-Of-Motion Lat Pulldown
nombre: Jalón cruzado en polea alta (recorrido completo)
instructions: Either standing or seated on a high bench, grasp two stirrup cables that are attached to the high pulleys. Grab with the opposing hand so your arms are crisscrossed about you and your palms are facing forward.

Keeping your chest up and maintaining a slight arch in your lower back, pull the handles down as if you were doing a regular pulldown. The range of motion will be more of an arc. During the movement, rotate your hands so that in the bottom position your palms face each other rather than forward. Return slowly to the starting position and repeat.
pasos: De pie o sentado en un banco alto, agarrá las dos manijas de las poleas altas con la mano contraria, de modo que los brazos queden cruzados arriba tuyo y las palmas hacia adelante.

Con el pecho arriba y la zona lumbar apenas arqueada, bajá las manijas como en un jalón común; el recorrido es más en arco. Durante el movimiento, girá las manos para que abajo las palmas queden enfrentadas. Volvé despacio y repetí.

name: Gironda Sternum Chins
instructions: Grasp the pull-up bar with a shoulder width underhand grip.
Now hang with your arms fully extended and stick your chest out and lean back. Tip: You will be leaning back throughout the entire movement. This will be your starting position.

Start pulling yourself towards the bar with your spine arched throughout the movement and your head leaning back as far away from the bar as possible. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: At the upper end of the movement, your hips and legs will be at about a 45-degree angle to the floor.

Keep pulling until your collarbone passes the bar and your lower chest or sternum area touches it. Hold that contraction for a second. Tip: By the time you've completed this portion of the movement; your head will be parallel to the floor.
Slowly start going back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Agarrá la barra con agarre supino al ancho de los hombros.
Colgá con los brazos estirados, sacá pecho e inclinate hacia atrás. Consejo: te mantenés inclinado hacia atrás todo el movimiento. Esta es la posición inicial.
Subí hacia la barra con la columna arqueada y la cabeza lo más atrás posible, soltando el aire. Consejo: arriba, cadera y piernas quedan a unos 45 grados del piso.
Seguí tirando hasta que la clavícula pase la barra y el esternón la toque. Sostené un segundo. Consejo: al final, la cabeza queda paralela al piso.
Volvé despacio a la posición inicial tomando aire.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Glute Ham Raise
instructions: Begin by adjusting the equipment to fit your body. Place your feet against the footplate in between the rollers as you lie facedown. Your knees should be just behind the pad.

Start from the bottom of the movement. Keep your back arched as you begin the movement by flexing the knees. Drive your toes into the foot plate as you do so. Keep your upper body straight, and continue until your body is upright.
Return to the starting position, keeping your descent under control.
pasos: Ajustá el aparato a tu cuerpo. Boca abajo, apoyá los pies en la placa entre los rodillos, con las rodillas justo detrás de la almohadilla.
Empezá desde abajo. Con la espalda arqueada, flexioná las rodillas empujando las puntas de los pies contra la placa. Mantené el torso recto y subí hasta quedar vertical.
Volvé a la posición inicial bajando con control.

name: Glute Kickback
instructions: Kneel on the floor or an exercise mat and bend at the waist with your arms extended in front of you (perpendicular to the torso) in order to get into a kneeling push-up position but with the arms spaced at shoulder width. Your head should be looking forward and the bend of the knees should create a 90-degree angle between the hamstrings and the calves. This will be your starting position.

As you exhale, lift up your right leg until the hamstrings are in line with the back while maintaining the 90-degree angle bend. Contract the glutes throughout this movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second. Tip: At the end of the movement the upper leg should be parallel to the floor while the calf should be perpendicular to it.
Go back to the initial position as you inhale and now repeat with the left leg.
Continue to alternate legs until all of the recommended repetitions have been performed.
pasos: Arrodillate en el piso o colchoneta e inclinate con los brazos estirados (perpendiculares al torso), al ancho de los hombros. Mirá al frente; las rodillas forman 90 grados entre isquiotibial y gemelo. Esta es la posición inicial.

Soltando el aire, subí la pierna derecha hasta que el muslo quede alineado con la espalda, manteniendo los 90 grados de la rodilla. Contraé los glúteos y sostené un segundo arriba. Consejo: al final, el muslo queda paralelo al piso y la pantorrilla perpendicular.
Volvé a la posición inicial tomando aire y repetí con la pierna izquierda.
Seguí alternando hasta completar las repeticiones.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Stand holding a light kettlebell by the horns close to your chest. This will be your starting position.
Squat down between your legs until your hamstrings are on your calves. Keep your chest and head up and your back straight.
At the bottom position, pause and use your elbows to push your knees out. Return to the starting position, and repeat for 10-20 repetitions.
pasos: Parate sosteniendo una pesa rusa liviana por los costados de la manija, cerca del pecho. Esta es la posición inicial.
Agachate entre las piernas hasta que los isquiotibiales toquen los gemelos, con pecho y cabeza arriba y espalda recta.
Abajo, pausá y usá los codos para empujar las rodillas hacia afuera. Volvé a la posición inicial y repetí 10 a 20 veces.

name: Good Morning
instructions: Begin with a bar on a rack at shoulder height. Rack the bar across the rear of your shoulders as you would a power squat, not on top of your shoulders. Keep your back tight, shoulder blades pinched together, and your knees slightly bent. Step back from the rack.
Begin by bending at the hips, moving them back as you bend over to near parallel. Keep your back arched and your cervical spine in proper alignment.
Reverse the motion by extending through the hips with your glutes and hamstrings. Continue until you have returned to the starting position.
pasos: Poné la barra en un rack a la altura de los hombros. Apoyala en la parte de atrás de los hombros como en una sentadilla de powerlifting, no arriba de los hombros. Espalda firme, omóplatos juntos y rodillas apenas flexionadas. Alejate del rack.
Flexioná la cadera llevándola atrás mientras te inclinás hasta casi quedar paralelo al piso. Espalda arqueada y cuello alineado.
Volvé extendiendo la cadera con glúteos e isquiotibiales hasta la posición inicial.

name: Good Morning off Pins
nombre: Buenos días desde los seguros del rack
instructions: Begin with a bar on a rack at about the same height as your stomach. Bend over underneath the bar and rack the bar across the rear of your shoulders as you would a power squat, not on top of your shoulders. At the proper height, you should be near parallel to the floor when bent over. Keep your back tight, shoulder blades pinched together, and your knees slightly bent. Keep your back arched and your cervical spine in proper alignment.
Begin the motion by extending through the hips with your glutes and hamstrings, and you are standing with the weight. Slowly lower the weight back to the pins returning to the starting position.
pasos: Poné la barra en el rack a la altura del abdomen, aproximadamente. Inclinate debajo y apoyala en la parte de atrás de los hombros, no arriba. A la altura correcta, inclinado quedás casi paralelo al piso. Espalda firme y arqueada, omóplatos juntos, rodillas apenas flexionadas y cuello alineado.
Extendé la cadera con glúteos e isquiotibiales hasta quedar de pie con el peso. Bajalo despacio hasta los seguros, volviendo a la posición inicial.

name: Gorilla Chin/Crunch
instructions: Hang from a chin-up bar using an underhand grip (palms facing you) that is slightly wider than shoulder width.
Now bend your knees at a 90 degree angle so that the calves are parallel to the floor while the thighs remain perpendicular to it. This will be your starting position.

As you exhale, pull yourself up while crunching your knees up at the same time until your knees are at chest level. You will stop going up as soon as your nose is at the same level as the bar. Tip: When you get to this point you should also be finishing the crunch at the same time.
Slowly start to inhale as you return to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Colgá de la barra con agarre supino (palmas hacia vos), un poco más ancho que los hombros.
Flexioná las rodillas a 90 grados: pantorrillas paralelas al piso y muslos perpendiculares. Esta es la posición inicial.
Soltando el aire, subí mientras llevás las rodillas al pecho. Frená cuando la nariz llegue a la altura de la barra. Consejo: en ese punto también terminás el crunch.
Volvé despacio a la posición inicial tomando aire.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Groin and Back Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet together.
Interlock your fingers behind your head. This will be your starting position.
Curl downwards, bringing your elbows to the inside of your thighs. After a brief pause, return to the starting position with your head up and your back straight. Repeat for 10-20 repetitions.
pasos: Sentate en el piso con las rodillas flexionadas y las plantas de los pies juntas.
Entrelazá los dedos detrás de la cabeza. Esta es la posición inicial.
Encorvate hacia abajo llevando los codos al interior de los muslos. Después de una pausa breve, volvé con la cabeza arriba y la espalda recta. Repetí 10 a 20 veces.

name: Groiners
nombre: Saltos de pies a manos desde plancha (groiners)
instructions: Begin in a pushup position on the floor. This will be your starting position.
Using both legs, jump forward landing with your feet next to your hands. Keep your head up as you do so.
Return to the starting position and immediately repeat the movement, continuing for 10-20 repetitions.
pasos: Empezá en posición de flexión en el piso. Esta es la posición inicial.
Con las dos piernas, saltá hacia adelante hasta caer con los pies al lado de las manos, con la cabeza arriba.
Volvé a la posición inicial y repetí enseguida, 10 a 20 veces.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided.
Position your legs in the platform using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Tip: Keep your head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.
Place your arms on the side handles of the machine and disengage the safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving the side handles from a facing front position to a diagonal position).

Now straighten your legs without locking the knees. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Begin to slowly lower the unit by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up (back on the pad at all times). Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the unit as you exhale by pushing the floor with mainly with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Apoyá la espalda en el respaldo de la máquina y meté los hombros debajo de las almohadillas.
Pies en la plataforma al ancho de los hombros, con las puntas un poco hacia afuera. Consejo: cabeza arriba y espalda apoyada todo el tiempo.
Agarrá las manijas laterales y sacá los seguros (en la mayoría de las máquinas se hace girando las manijas de frente a diagonal).
Estirá las piernas sin bloquear las rodillas. Esta es la posición inicial.

Bajá despacio flexionando las rodillas, con la espalda apoyada y la cabeza arriba, hasta que el ángulo entre muslo y gemelo sea un poco menor a 90 grados. Tomá aire. Consejo: la rodilla queda alineada con la punta del pie; si la pasa, cargás de más la rodilla.
Subí soltando el aire, empujando sobre todo con el talón, hasta la posición inicial.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Hammer Curls
instructions: Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell on each hand being held at arms length. The elbows should be close to the torso.
The palms of the hands should be facing your torso. This will be your starting position.

Now, while holding your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weight forward while contracting the biceps. Continue to raise the weight until the biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a brief moment as you squeeze the biceps. Tip: Focus on keeping the elbow stationary and only moving your forearm.
After the brief pause, inhale and slowly begin the lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Parate con el torso derecho y una mancuerna en cada mano, brazos estirados y codos cerca del cuerpo.
Las palmas miran hacia el cuerpo. Esta es la posición inicial.
Sin mover la parte superior del brazo, soltá el aire y subí el peso contrayendo el bíceps hasta la altura del hombro. Sostené un momento apretando. Consejo: codo quieto, solo se mueve el antebrazo.
Después de la pausa, tomá aire y bajá despacio a la posición inicial.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Hammer Grip Incline DB Bench Press
nombre: Press inclinado con mancuernas agarre neutro
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.
By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbells up, clean the dumbbells one arm at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.

Once at shoulder width, keep the palms of your hands with a neutral grip (palms facing each other). Keep your elbows flared out with the upper arms in line with the shoulders (perpendicular to the torso) and the elbows bent creating a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm. This will be your starting position.
Now bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe in. Keep full control of the dumbbells at all times.

As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the dumbbells back in your thighs and then on the floor. This is the safest manner to dispose of the dumbbells.
pasos: Recostate en un banco inclinado con una mancuerna en cada mano sobre los muslos, palmas enfrentadas.
Ayudándote con los muslos, subí las mancuernas de a una hasta sostenerlas al ancho de los hombros.
Mantené el agarre neutro (palmas enfrentadas), codos abiertos con la parte superior del brazo alineada con los hombros y a 90 grados del antebrazo. Esta es la posición inicial.
Bajá las pesas despacio hacia los costados tomando aire, siempre con control.
Soltando el aire, empujá las mancuernas hacia arriba con el pecho. Bloqueá los brazos, sostené un segundo y bajá despacio. Consejo: bajar tiene que durar al menos el doble que subir.
Repetí las veces indicadas.
Al terminar, apoyá las mancuernas en los muslos y después en el piso: es la forma más segura de dejarlas.

name: Hamstring-SMR
instructions: In a seated position, extend your legs over a foam roll so that it is position on the back of the upper legs. Place your hands to the side or behind you to help support your weight. This will be your starting position.
Using your hands, lift your hips off of the floor and shift your weight on the foam roll to one leg. Relax the hamstrings of the leg you are stretching.
Roll over the foam from below the hip to above the back of the knee, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat for the other leg.
pasos: Sentado, apoyá la parte de atrás de los muslos sobre un rodillo de espuma. Las manos al costado o atrás para sostener el peso. Esta es la posición inicial.
Con las manos, levantá la cadera y cargá el peso sobre una pierna. Relajá los isquiotibiales de esa pierna.
Rodá desde abajo de la cadera hasta arriba de la parte de atrás de la rodilla, frenando 10 a 30 segundos en los puntos de tensión. Repetí con la otra pierna.

name: Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with one leg extended above you, with the hip at ninety degrees. Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Loop a belt, band, or rope over the ball of your foot. This will be your starting position.
Pull on the belt to create tension in the calves and hamstrings. Hold this stretch for 10-30 seconds, and repeat with the other leg.
pasos: Acostate boca arriba con una pierna estirada hacia arriba, cadera a 90 grados, y la otra apoyada en el piso.
Pasá un cinturón, banda o soga por la parte delantera del pie. Esta es la posición inicial.
Tirá del cinturón para tensar gemelos e isquiotibiales. Sostené 10 a 30 segundos y cambiá de pierna.

name: Handstand Push-Ups
nombre: Flexiones en vertical contra la pared
instructions: With your back to the wall bend at the waist and place both hands on the floor at shoulder width.

Kick yourself up against the wall with your arms straight. Your body should be upside down with the arms and legs fully extended. Keep your whole body as straight as possible. Tip: If doing this for the first time, have a spotter help you. Also, make sure that you keep facing the wall with your head, rather than looking down.
Slowly lower yourself to the ground as you inhale until your head almost touches the floor. Tip: It is of utmost importance that you come down slow in order to avoid head injury.
Push yourself back up slowly as you exhale until your elbows are nearly locked.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: De espaldas a la pared, inclinate y apoyá las dos manos en el piso al ancho de los hombros.

Impulsate con las piernas hasta quedar cabeza abajo contra la pared, con brazos y piernas estirados y el cuerpo lo más recto posible. Consejo: la primera vez, hacelo con alguien que te asista, y mirá hacia la pared, no hacia abajo.
Bajá despacio tomando aire hasta que la cabeza casi toque el piso. Consejo: es fundamental bajar lento para no lastimarte la cabeza.
Empujá despacio hacia arriba soltando el aire hasta casi bloquear los codos.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Hang Clean
instructions: Begin with a shoulder width, double overhand or hook grip, with the bar hanging at the mid thigh position. Your back should be straight and inclined slightly forward.
Begin by aggressively extending through the hips, knees and ankles, driving the weight upward. As you do so, shrug your shoulders towards your ears.
Immediately recover by driving through the heels, keeping the torso upright and elbows up. Continue until you have risen to a standing position.
pasos: Agarrá la barra al ancho de los hombros con doble agarre prono o de gancho, colgando a la mitad del muslo. Espalda recta y apenas inclinada hacia adelante.
Extendé con fuerza cadera, rodillas y tobillos para subir el peso, encogiendo los hombros hacia las orejas.
Recuperá enseguida empujando con los talones, con el torso derecho y los codos arriba, hasta quedar de pie.

name: Hang Clean - Below the Knees
nombre: Cargada colgante desde debajo de las rodillas
instructions: Begin with a shoulder width, double overhand or hook grip, with the bar hanging just below the knees. Your back should be straight and inclined slightly forward.

Begin by aggressively extending through the hips, knees and ankles, driving the weight upward. As you do so, shrug your shoulders towards your ears. As full extension is achieved, transition into the third pull by aggressively shrugging and flexing the arms with the elbows up and out.

At peak extension, aggressively pull yourself down, rotating your elbows under the bar as you do so. Receive the bar in a front squat position, the depth of which is dependent upon the height of the bar at the end of the third pull. The bar should be racked onto the protracted shoulders, lightly touching the throat with the hands relaxed. Continue to descend to the bottom squat position, which will help in the recovery.
Immediately recover by driving through the heels, keeping the torso upright and elbows up. Continue until you have risen to a standing position.
pasos: Agarrá la barra al ancho de los hombros con doble agarre prono o de gancho, colgando justo debajo de las rodillas. Espalda recta y apenas inclinada hacia adelante.

Extendé con fuerza cadera, rodillas y tobillos para subir el peso, encogiendo los hombros. Con la extensión completa, pasá al tercer tirón encogiendo los hombros con fuerza y flexionando los brazos con los codos arriba y afuera.

En el punto más alto, bajá rápido debajo de la barra girando los codos por debajo. Recibila en sentadilla frontal, más o menos profunda según la altura alcanzada, apoyada en los hombros adelantados, rozando la garganta y con las manos relajadas. Bajá hasta el fondo de la sentadilla.
Recuperá enseguida empujando con los talones, con el torso derecho y los codos arriba, hasta quedar de pie.

name: Hang Snatch
instructions: Begin with a wide grip on the bar, with an overhand or hook grip. The feet should be directly below the hips with the feet turned out. Your knees should be slightly bent, and the torso inclined forward. The spine should be fully extended and the head facing forward. The bar should be at the hips. This will be your starting position.
Aggressively extend through the legs and hips. At peak extension, shrug the shoulders and allow the elbows to flex to the side.

As you move your feet into the receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar overhead. Receive the bar with your body as low as possible and the arms fully extended overhead.
Return to a standing position with the weight overhead. Follow by returning the weight to the ground under control.
pasos: Agarrá la barra con agarre ancho, prono o de gancho. Pies debajo de la cadera con las puntas hacia afuera, rodillas apenas flexionadas y torso inclinado hacia adelante. Columna bien extendida, mirada al frente y barra a la altura de la cadera. Esta es la posición inicial.
Extendé con fuerza piernas y cadera. En el punto de máxima extensión, encogé los hombros y dejá que los codos se flexionen hacia los costados.
Mientras llevás los pies a la posición de recepción, metete con fuerza debajo de la barra mientras la subís arriba de la cabeza. Recibila lo más abajo posible, con los brazos estirados arriba.
Ponete de pie con el peso arriba y después bajalo al piso con control.

name: Hang Snatch - Below Knees
nombre: Arranque colgante desde debajo de las rodillas
instructions: Begin with a wide grip on the bar, with an overhand or hook grip. The feet should be directly below the hips with the feet turned out. Your knees should be slightly bent, and the torso inclined forward. The spine should be fully extended and the head facing forward. The bar should be just below the knees. This will be your starting position.
Aggressively extend through the legs and hips. At peak extension, shrug the shoulders and allow the elbows to flex to the side.

As you move your feet into the receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar overhead. Receive the bar with your body as low as possible and the arms fully extended overhead.
Return to a standing position with the weight overhead, and then return the weight to the floor under control.
pasos: Agarrá la barra con agarre ancho, prono o de gancho. Pies debajo de la cadera con las puntas hacia afuera, rodillas apenas flexionadas y torso inclinado hacia adelante. Columna extendida, mirada al frente y barra justo debajo de las rodillas. Esta es la posición inicial.
Extendé con fuerza piernas y cadera. En el punto de máxima extensión, encogé los hombros y dejá que los codos se flexionen hacia los costados.
Mientras llevás los pies a la posición de recepción, metete con fuerza debajo de la barra mientras la subís arriba de la cabeza. Recibila lo más abajo posible, con los brazos estirados.
Ponete de pie con el peso arriba y después bajalo al piso con control.

name: Hanging Bar Good Morning
nombre: Buenos días con barra colgada de cadenas
instructions: Begin with a bar on a rack at about the same height as your stomach. Suspend the bar using chains or suspension straps.

Bend over underneath the bar and rack the bar across the rear of your shoulders as you would a power squat, not on top of your traps. At the proper height, you should be near parallel to the floor when bent over. Keep your back tight, shoulder blades pinched together, and your knees slightly bent. Keep your back arched and your cervical spine in proper alignment.
Begin the motion by extending through the hips with your glutes and hamstrings, and you are standing with the weight.
Slowly lower the weight back to the starting position, where it is supported by the chains.
pasos: Poné la barra en un rack a la altura del abdomen, colgada de cadenas o correas.

Inclinate debajo de la barra y apoyala en la parte de atrás de los hombros como en una sentadilla de powerlifting, no arriba de los trapecios. A la altura correcta, inclinado quedás casi paralelo al piso. Espalda firme y arqueada, omóplatos juntos, rodillas apenas flexionadas y cuello alineado.
Extendé la cadera con glúteos e isquiotibiales hasta quedar de pie con el peso.
Bajá despacio hasta que las cadenas vuelvan a sostener la barra.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a chin-up bar with both arms extended at arms length in top of you using either a wide grip or a medium grip. The legs should be straight down with the pelvis rolled slightly backwards. This will be your starting position.
Raise your legs until the torso makes a 90-degree angle with the legs. Exhale as you perform this movement and hold the contraction for a second or so.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Colgá de una barra de dominadas con los brazos estirados, agarre ancho o medio. Piernas rectas hacia abajo y pelvis apenas rotada hacia atrás. Esta es la posición inicial.
Subí las piernas hasta que formen 90 grados con el torso, soltando el aire, y sostené un segundo.
Bajá despacio a la posición inicial tomando aire.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Hanging Pike
instructions: Hang from a chin-up bar with your legs and feet together using an overhand grip (palms facing away from you) that is slightly wider than shoulder width. Tip: You may use wrist wraps in order to facilitate holding on to the bar.

Now bend your knees at a 90 degree angle and bring the upper legs forward so that the calves are perpendicular to the floor while the thighs remain parallel to it. This will be your starting position.
Pull your legs up as you exhale until you almost touch your shins with the bar above you. Tip: Try to straighten your legs as much as possible while at the top.
Lower your legs as slowly as possible until you reach the starting position. Tip: Avoid swinging and using momentum at all times.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Colgá de la barra con piernas y pies juntos y agarre prono (palmas hacia afuera), un poco más ancho que los hombros. Consejo: podés usar straps para sostenerte mejor.
Flexioná las rodillas a 90 grados y llevá los muslos adelante, paralelos al piso, con las pantorrillas perpendiculares. Esta es la posición inicial.
Subí las piernas soltando el aire hasta casi tocar la barra con las canillas. Consejo: arriba, estirá las piernas todo lo que puedas.
Bajá las piernas lo más lento posible hasta la posición inicial. Consejo: nunca te balancees ni uses impulso.
Repetí las veces indicadas.

name: Heaving Snatch Balance
instructions: This drill helps you learn the snatch. Begin by holding a light weight across the back of the shoulders. Your feet should be slightly wider than hip width apart with the feet turned out, the same position that you would perform a squat with.
Begin by dipping with the knees slightly, and popping back up to briefly unload the bar. Drive yourself underneath the bar, elevating it overhead as you descend into a full squat.
Return to a standing position.
pasos: Este ejercicio ayuda a aprender el arranque. Sostené un peso liviano en la parte de atrás de los hombros, con los pies un poco más abiertos que la cadera y las puntas hacia afuera, como para una sentadilla.
Flexioná un poco las rodillas y rebotá hacia arriba para descargar la barra un instante. Metete debajo de la barra, subiéndola arriba de la cabeza mientras bajás a una sentadilla completa.
Volvé a quedar de pie.

name: Heavy Bag Thrust
instructions: Utilize a heavy bag for this exercise. Assume an upright stance next to the bag, with your feet staggered, fairly wide apart. Place your hand on the bag at about chest height. This will be your starting position.
Begin by twisting at the waist, pushing the bag forward as hard as possible. Perform this move quickly, pushing the bag away from your body.
Receive the bag as it swings back by reversing these steps.
pasos: Usá una bolsa de boxeo pesada. Parate derecho al lado de la bolsa, con los pies escalonados y bastante separados. Apoyá la mano en la bolsa a la altura del pecho. Esta es la posición inicial.
Girá la cintura y empujá la bolsa hacia adelante lo más fuerte posible, rápido y alejándola del cuerpo.
Recibí la bolsa cuando vuelve, haciendo el movimiento al revés.

name: High Cable Curls
instructions: Stand between a couple of high pulleys and grab a handle in each arm. Position your upper arms in a way that they are parallel to the floor with the palms of your hands facing you. This will be your starting position.

Curl the handles towards you until they are next to your ears. Make sure that as you do so you flex your biceps and exhale. The upper arms should remain stationary and only the forearms should move. Hold for a second in the contracted position as you squeeze the biceps.
Slowly bring back the arms to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
pasos: Parate entre dos poleas altas y agarrá una manija con cada mano. La parte superior de los brazos va paralela al piso, con las palmas hacia vos. Esta es la posición inicial.
Llevá las manijas hacia vos hasta que queden al lado de las orejas, flexionando los bíceps y soltando el aire. Solo se mueven los antebrazos. Sostené un segundo apretando.
Volvé despacio a la posición inicial.
Repetí las veces indicadas.
